requiredEvidence: Identity, date of birth and an active owned INR savings account
Fresh posted net salary or pension evidence and declared essential spending and debt obligations
An active owned fixed deposit, its maturity date, and all existing liens
Customer confirmation that pledged funds are not emergency or near-term committed reserves

mainTradeoff: The pledged deposit is unavailable while the loan remains outstanding, and borrowing still requires affordable repayment from evidenced income.

sourceDocuments.title: Proposed deposit-backed small-loan terms
sourceDocuments.text: Synthetic proposal: INR 10,000-2,00,000; 3-24 months; fixed 9.50% nominal annual reducing-balance interest; zero processing, annual and prepayment fees; INR 250 per overdue instalment, no penalty interest. Minimum age 18; maximum age at maturity 80. Fresh income and obligations evidence, an active owned account, and an unencumbered non-emergency fixed deposit are required. Loan principal is at most 75% of deposit principal and final repayment is no later than deposit maturity. Independent bank decision and explicit customer confirmation remain necessary.

authority: A newly proposed synthetic 12-month insurance contract, not an amendment to or prior approval of CB-HEALTH-BASE. External package review/pin, rollout, independent runtime underwriting and customer confirmation are required.

parameters.roomRentLimitBasis: One percent of sum insured per covered inpatient day; INR 5,000.

activationPolicy.renewal: No automatic renewal or guaranteed renewal price. A future term needs a separately sourced offer, fresh assessment and customer confirmation. No continuity waiver is assumed.
activationPolicy.premiumTerms: Twelve monthly INR 3,850 instalments, INR 46,200 total; the first instalment is debited only on confirmed activation. Amounts include all simulated charges; no additional tax is charged by the demo.
activationPolicy.cancellation: Customer may request prospective cancellation through servicing; cessation of future instalments and any refund require a separately verified cancellation settlement. No automatic or assumed refund.
activationPolicy.benefitLimit: Covered eligible inpatient expenses up to INR 5,00,000 aggregate during the 12-month term, never more than actual unreimbursed eligible expense.
exclusions: Expenses before activation and the already-known current episode or procedure are not retroactively insured.
Illness claims within the initial 30-day waiting period; a new accidental injury after activation is excepted from that initial wait only.
Pre-existing conditions and related treatment during the 24-month waiting period; these remain excluded throughout this initial 12-month term.
Routine outpatient consultations, health checks, elective cosmetic treatment and non-medical personal charges.
Amounts already reimbursed by another policy, and expenses above the stated sum insured or room-rent limit.
Treatment outside India and fraudulent or deliberately misrepresented claims.

requiredEvidence: Owned identity and date of birth
Complete current source-verified health declaration, including diagnoses, treatment, planned procedures and existing cover
Current income, obligations and premium affordability
Explicit customer confirmation after an independent current underwriting decision
rateTerms: Fixed demo premium INR 3,850 monthly for a 12-month term; total INR 46,200, sum insured INR 5,00,000, no co-pay or deductible. This is not an investment and earns no interest.
fees: Issuance fee INR 0; no additional simulated taxes or charges.
liquidityTerms: The first monthly premium is payable on activation; eleven further monthly premiums are commitments. Premiums are not withdrawable savings. Cancellation/refund needs a separate verified servicing outcome.
benefits: A fully specified future inpatient-cover option for a customer without adequate existing base cover.
mainTradeoff: Premiums consume monthly surplus, and waiting periods and exclusions leave known current treatment and pre-existing conditions outside this initial term.
limitations: Entry ages 18-65 inclusive; exactly 12 months and fixed INR 5,00,000 cover.
Not retroactive cover, a current claim approval or guaranteed renewal.
Source verification of a declaration is not underwriting approval.
whyNotSuitable: A current bill needing reimbursement, unaffordable ongoing premiums, or duplicative existing cover without a demonstrated additional need.
disclosureText: PROPOSED SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. Pricing borrows the existing base-cover illustration, but these complete contractual terms are new proposals and were not approved with retail4-v1.

sourceDocuments.title: Proposed future health base policy schedule and wording
sourceDocuments.text: NEW PROPOSED SYNTHETIC CONTRACT, future-cover-policy-v1-proposed; not existing approved policy wording. Insurer Meridian Demo Assurance (fictional), territory India, entry ages 18-65 inclusive, exactly 12 months from confirmed activation. Fixed annual aggregate sum insured INR 5,00,000; monthly premium INR 3,850, twelve instalments totalling INR 46,200, first on activation. No issuance fee or additional simulated taxes. No co-pay or deductible. Inpatient room rent capped at 1% of sum insured per covered day (INR 5,000). Related eligible pre-hospitalisation up to 30 days and post-hospitalisation up to 60 days remain subject to the same term, limits and exclusions. Initial illness waiting period 30 days; a new accidental injury after activation is excepted from that initial wait only. Pre-existing-condition waiting period 24 months means no such cover throughout this initial 12-month term. Excluded: pre-activation expenses and the already-known current episode/procedure; routine outpatient consultations/checkups, elective cosmetic treatment and non-medical personal charges; costs already reimbursed elsewhere or above policy/room-rent limits; treatment outside India; fraudulent or deliberate misrepresentation. Benefits never exceed actual unreimbursed eligible expense. No automatic renewal, guaranteed renewal premium or continuity waiver; another term requires separately sourced terms, fresh assessment and customer confirmation. Cancellation is prospective by servicing request; any stopped instalments/refund needs a verified settlement, never an assumed credit. A complete source-verified health declaration and affordability evidence are underwriting inputs only. Independent runtime underwriting and exact customer confirmation are required; this document does not contain a case approval.

authority: A newly proposed synthetic top-up contract, not an amendment to or prior approval of CB-HEALTH-TOPUP. Requires an externally pinned opt-in package, runtime underwriting and customer confirmation.

parameters.deductibleBasis: Eligible expenses aggregated over this policy's 12-month term; deductible must be met before top-up benefit.
parameters.roomRentLimitBasis: No additional room-rent sublimit; eligible actual costs and all other limits still apply.

activationPolicy.renewal: No automatic or guaranteed renewal, price or continuity waiver; each future term requires a separately sourced offer and confirmation.
activationPolicy.premiumTerms: Twelve monthly INR 1,200 instalments, INR 14,400 total, first on confirmed activation. No additional simulated taxes or charges.
activationPolicy.cancellation: Prospective cancellation through servicing; any refund or cessation of future instalments requires a separate verified settlement.
activationPolicy.benefitLimit: Eligible unreimbursed inpatient expense above INR 5,00,000 annual aggregate deductible, less 10% co-pay, subject to INR 10,00,000 aggregate insurer benefit during this term.
exclusions: Expenses before activation and the already-known current episode or procedure are not retroactively insured.
Initial 30-day illness waiting period; new accidental injury after activation is excepted from that initial wait only.
Pre-existing conditions and related treatment during 24 months; therefore excluded throughout this initial 12-month term.
The INR 5,00,000 annual aggregate deductible, the 10% co-pay and amounts reimbursed by another policy.
Routine outpatient/checkup, elective cosmetic and non-medical personal costs; costs above policy limits.
Treatment outside India and fraudulent or deliberately misrepresented claims.

requiredEvidence: Owned identity and date of birth
Complete fresh source-verified health declaration
An active owned base policy covering at least the INR 5,00,000 deductible
Current premium affordability and independent runtime underwriting
Explicit customer confirmation of waiting periods, deductible and co-pay
rateTerms: INR 1,200 monthly for exactly 12 months, total INR 14,400. Up to INR 10,00,000 insurer benefit after INR 5,00,000 annual aggregate deductible and 10% co-pay. No investment return.
fees: Issuance fee INR 0; no additional simulated taxes or charges.
liquidityTerms: Premiums are recurring commitments, not refundable savings. The base policy/deductible remains separately funded and cannot be counted as new cash.
benefits: Additional prospective coverage above an evidenced existing base policy rather than another duplicate base policy.
mainTradeoff: Lower premium comes with a substantial deductible, co-pay and waiting periods. It does not fund the currently known procedure.
limitations: Entry ages 18-65; exactly 12 months and fixed INR 10,00,000 benefit limit.
An active base policy must cover the deductible.
No current-claim promise, automatic renewal, assumed continuity waiver or authored underwriting approval.
whyNotSuitable: No qualifying base cover, an immediate medical funding need or insufficient ongoing premium budget.
disclosureText: PROPOSED SYNTHETIC DEMO POLICY. These complete annual-aggregate deductible and coverage terms are new, not prior approved retail4-v1 wording.

sourceDocuments.title: Proposed future health top-up policy schedule and wording
sourceDocuments.text: NEW PROPOSED SYNTHETIC CONTRACT, future-cover-policy-v1-proposed. Meridian Demo Assurance (fictional); India only; entry ages 18-65; exactly 12 months from confirmed activation. Monthly premium INR 1,200, twelve instalments INR 14,400 total, first on activation; zero issuance fee and no added simulated taxes. An owned active base policy must cover the INR 5,00,000 deductible. Deductible is eligible expense aggregated over this policy term, not a cash credit. Above it, a 10% co-pay applies and insurer benefit is capped at INR 10,00,000 aggregate; no expense can be reimbursed twice. No additional room-rent sublimit; eligible related pre/post-hospitalisation windows are 30/60 days within the term and other limits. Illness waiting period 30 days except new accidental injury after activation. Pre-existing-condition waiting period 24 months excludes these throughout this initial 12-month term. Excluded: pre-activation and already-known current episode/procedure expenses; deductible and co-pay; amounts paid by another policy; routine outpatient/checkup, elective cosmetic and non-medical personal costs; costs above limits; non-India treatment; fraudulent/deliberate misrepresentation. No automatic renewal, guaranteed future price or continuity waiver. Cancellation is prospective through servicing; refund or stopped instalments require verified settlement. A fresh complete health declaration, verified base policy and affordability evidence are inputs to independent runtime underwriting, not an insurer-acceptance fixture. Exact customer confirmation is necessary.

authority: Proposed synthetic demo service. Not part of the approved retail4-v1 release; requires a separately pinned opt-in rollout.

parameters.interestTreatment: No additional interest; money earns only the linked account's existing rate.
parameters.balanceTreatment: Earmark within an owned linked account; not another asset, loan, deposit or cash credit.

requiredEvidence: An active owned INR savings account
Customer-stated purpose, optional target date and allocation within spendable surplus
Customer confirmation before any amount is earmarked
rateTerms: No separate interest rate or incremental yield. The linked savings account's unchanged terms alone apply to its balance.
fees: Opening, monthly, withdrawal and closure fees: INR 0.
liquidityTerms: An optional earmark, releasable immediately without penalty. It must not duplicate the account balance or consume money already protected or pledged.
benefits: Keep the purpose of savings visible without a compulsory instalment or term lock.
mainTradeoff: It provides organisation, not extra return, insurance, credit or a legal tax segregation.
limitations: Allocation INR 0 to INR 10,00,000; an unfunded goal contains no money.
Optional target horizon 0 to 120 months; no maturity or penalty is created.
Minimum age 18. No maximum age or mandatory term applies.
Existing reserves and earmarks must be counted only once.
whyNotSuitable: A requirement for guaranteed investment return, insurance protection or money that has not actually arrived.
disclosureText: PROPOSED SYNTHETIC DEMO SERVICE. Internal allocation is not a new deposit sale and carries no simulated revenue.

sourceDocuments.title: Proposed goal-pocket terms
sourceDocuments.text: Synthetic proposal: an optional INR 0-10,00,000 earmark in an active owned INR savings account; minimum age 18; optional target horizon 0-120 months. No compulsory contributions, new cash, additional interest, opening fee, monthly fee, withdrawal fee or closure penalty. Money retains only the linked account's existing interest terms and is instantly releasable. A funded pocket must not count the same cash twice or encumber emergency reserves. Explicit customer confirmation is required; no credit decision is needed.
